title: A search with no match says so, with Clear Search
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Type zzqqzz in the search.
  3. Click Clear Search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the General Matrix first.

Step 2:

  • The list area reads 'No matrices match the search "zzqqzz".'
  • A Clear Search button shows under it.

Step 3:

  • The search is empty.
  • Every matrix is listed again.
